newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end flat, seen treading water.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end flat, seen treading water.

text.p: 1415 GMT - Austrian shares close flat on meagre turnover.
Traders see ATX index well supported at 1,210 points and holding steady ahead of futures expiry on Friday, barring the emergence of fresh incentives.
* ATX index down just 0.01 percent, or 0.11 points, at 1,213.69.
* Top gainer OMV, up 1.14 percent at 1,371 ats.
* Leading decliner Boehler, down 1.53 percent at 806.5 ats.
* March ATX future down one point at 1,213 points. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
